title: StoreIndex
description: On disk format of STORE/index.json, the server's persistent hash record. Written with an atomic replace, so it is never observed half updated. This is server state, not an API response: it carries no sizeHuman and no per entry hashAlgorithm.

formatVersion.description: Format of this file. The server refuses to start on an unknown value rather than guessing.

hashAlgorithm.description: Algorithm behind every hash in this file.

chunkMin.description: Block parameters the store was built with. Block boundaries depend on them, so starting the server with different values is refused: mixing them would silently destroy deduplication between versions. Use --force-reindex to rebuild the store instead.

versions.description: One entry per ingested archive, ordered by id ascending.
